title: Multi-Modal Email Assistant
description: A sophisticated email assistant combining RAG, image generation, and web research for creating high-quality, multi-modal email content

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Combines RAG with Bedrock Knowledge Base for contextual email composition
Integrates Nova Canvas for dynamic image generation in emails
Features web research capabilities for up-to-date content
Implements multi-modal content handling and composition
Provides tools for retrieving, generating, and composing email content
